title: Boobstrap Configuration
description: Configuration schema for customizing and compiling Boobstrap CSS stylesheets.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON schema.

palettes.description: Color palettes to include in the compiled stylesheet. Pass false to omit optional palettes and keep only default brand/gray.

radii.description: Border radius presets to include in the compiled stylesheet. Pass false to omit preset classes.

components.description: Component stylesheets to include in the bundle. Use 'all' or provide an array of specific component names to tree-shake unused components.

utilities.description: Utility groups to include in the bundle. Use 'all' or provide an array of specific utility names.

tokens.description: Custom token overrides mapped to CSS variable names or shorthand names.

layers.description: Whether to wrap stylesheet rules in CSS @layer (bs.base, bs.layout, bs.components, bs.utilities).

autoColorScheme.description: Whether to include @media (prefers-color-scheme) automatic dark/light theme switching.

static.description: Whether to inline static token values directly (replacing var(--bs-*) lookups with concrete values).

minify.description: Whether to minify the generated CSS stylesheet using esbuild.

outFile.description: Output path where the compiled CSS file should be written.
